name: Tachibana
source:
A cleaner who seems cursed(?) never to grow old. He is fond of Cocoro, and spends his time repaying her kindness as her neighbor. He is searching for a way to unlock the curse so they can experience the flow of time together.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227510/Algorithm_Prescription/]Steam[/url]]
